units.source_text: 源氏看见玉鬘长得美好，心甚欢悦，便描述给紫姬听。

en.t: When Genji saw how beautifully Tamakazura had grown, he was delighted and described her to Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 他说：“这个人长年流落在这种穷乡僻壤，我料想她长得不成样子，看不起她。

en.t: He said, "After all these years of drifting about in such a remote backwater, I expected her to look quite wretched and thought little of her.

units.source_text: 岂知一见之后，反而使我觉得可耻。

en.t: But once I saw her, it was I who felt ashamed.

units.source_text: 我定要宣扬出去，叫大家知道我家有这个美人。

en.t: I must spread the word and let everyone know that such a beauty is in my house.

units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王常常注目于我家的女人，如今好叫他尝尝相思滋味了。

en.t: Prince Hyobukyo is always casting his eye on the women of my household; now I can let him taste the pangs of longing.

units.source_text: 那些好色之徒到这里来，总是装得一本正经，就为了我家没有香饵之故。

en.t: Those amorous fellows come here and always put on a solemn face only because my house has had no fragrant bait.

units.source_text: 我要好好地教养这妮子，管教这些人都脱下假面具来。”

en.t: I shall raise this girl properly and make every one of them take off his mask."

units.source_text: 紫姬说：“哪有这种糊涂爷！

en.t: Lady Murasaki said, "What an absurd father you are!

units.source_text: 找得一个女儿来，首先要她诱惑人心。

en.t: You find yourself a daughter, and the first thing you want is for her to tempt men's hearts.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“老实说，我从前如果也像今日一般悠闲，定然教你做香饵。

en.t: Genji said, "To tell the truth, if I had been as leisurely in the past as I am today, I would certainly have trained you to be the fragrant bait.

units.source_text: 当时不曾考虑到，就成了这局面。”

en.t: I did not think of it then, and so things have turned out like this."
After saying this, he burst into loud laughter.

units.source_text: 紫姬被他说得红晕满颊，样子异常娇艳。

en.t: Lady Murasaki blushed deeply at his words, and looked extraordinarily lovely and radiant.

units.source_text: 源氏便取过笔砚来，随意题诗一首：

en.t: Genji then drew the brush and inkstone toward him and casually wrote a poem:
